name: 6x6
note: published: problem(3) of https://github.com/hakank/hakank/blob/master/picat/futoshiki.pi, from sudoku-puzzles.net (futoshiki06x6); a larger grid with only two inequalities; unique solution.

name: 4x4 generated
note: generated: Python random.Random(1): a random 4x4 Latin square (cyclic square with rows, columns and symbols shuffled), then clues added in a repeating cycle of two inequalities between random adjacent cells, then one given digit at a random cell, until the solution is unique (4 givens, 10 inequalities). Smaller than the example.
